content.text: Here’s another Sidewalks Entertainment Guest News: Paramount + has announced that “Landman” has been renewed for season 3. Created by Taylor Sheridan and Christian Wallace, the oil-based drama stars our previous guests Billy Bob Thornton and Ali Larter. The renewal comes after the second season premiere became the most-watched premiere of any Paramount+ original series ever, garnering over 9.2 million streams in its first two days. “Landman” is a contemporary drama set amidst the volatile West Texas oil boom, exploring the high-stakes environment of roughnecks, landmen, and billionaires. The series centers on Tommy Norris, a crisis executive for an oil company who manages drilling rights and field issues, portrayed by Billy Bob Thornton. The cast also features Ali Larter as his ex-wife, Angela Norris. Congrats to the cast and production crew. Are you a fan of the show and excited about the renewal news? #Landman #renew #season3 #BillyBobThornton #AliLarter #ParamountPlus #guestnews #SidewalksEntertainment **** More celebrity interviews at our official website: https://www.SidewalksTV.com.
